h1: What Drinking Alcohol Does to Your Skin

blocks.html: Over the course of treating patients, there are a few categories that we have noticed that cause premature aging to skin. When people think of premature aging, they mostly attribute it to sun damage, a widely recognized contributor to the degradation of healthy skin. Another factor is smoking.  Both are horrible for your skin and can be known to cause cancer and even death.

What many people may not realize is there is a third danger to your skin-drinking alcohol.  We are not referencing the occasional glass of wine here and there. We are talking about those who drink 2-3 glasses of a cocktail, beer, or wine every night. We have noticed that those who drink 2-3 glasses of an alcoholic beverage every night, tend to look years older than they should.  The good news is that all three of these contributors to the aging of your skin are either completely avoidable or can be limited such as with sun exposure.

For those who are drinking 2-3 glasses of an alcoholic beverage every night, it is important to fully hydrate your body with water.  A great rule is to drink one glass of water for every one drink of alcohol you consume.  This will help keep you hydrated and reduce the effect the alcohol has.  Alcohol is a diuretic and it can tend to dehydrate your body.

Skin that is dehydrated tends to look flaky, dull, show increased wrinkles and fine lines, appear sunken in, and overall just looks deflated. There have been studies conducted that show the miracle of increasing water intake and the positive effect that is has on counteracting the appearance of aging.
